item.title: Tree branches, 2nd November
item.description:
I am writing to report a dangerous safety hazard at Galleons Park, located right next to the walking path. There are two problematic branches on one of the trees near the path: One branch has completely broken off and is lying on the ground. Another branch has snapped and is currently hanging precariously from the tree, posing an immediate risk of falling on someone's head.
